en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Is’haq, from Sa’adan Bin Muslim, from Abu Baseer, and someone else, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘From the respect of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic is the respect for the Muslim with an old age’.
en.sarwar: 6. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ahmad ibn Ishaq from Sa’dan ibn Muslim from abu Basir and others from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
It is honoring Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, to honor an old Muslim.”
